observations: Fixed oracle-U0 route samples for the held-out source/seed at all five inference arms; never swap observations together with model wind.

folds.held_out: Exclude the query seed from both candidate sources and all wind template libraries

HIT_FORWARD.claim_limit: PMFS-compatible two-candidate forward surrogate; no native PMFS parity or closed-loop claim

LOG_GAUSSIAN.train_mean: 3-seed arithmetic mean at each route point
LOG_GAUSSIAN.flux: known fixed release; no fit or per-source amplitude profiling

WRONG_MODEL_BMA.report: model evidence rank, model posterior weights and blended source posterior for both likelihood families
WRONG_MODEL_BMA.claims: Generic model-averaging prior-art comparator, not a novel contribution or an exact Piro implementation

source_metrics.primary_damage: Brier_model - Brier_oracle; negative means rescue, retain all signs
source_metrics.NLL: -log(max(p_true,1e-15)); retain raw posterior and log evidence
source_metrics.tie_policy: rank=1.5, top1=false, worst-case MAP error=2 m; no favourable source-index tie break
source_metrics.top2: constant 1 for two candidates; no evidence value

forward_metrics.footprint_grid: Native cell-centre indices stride=2 at 0.25 m; ROI x/y 40*32; integrate all Free simulation z samples with 0.5 m quadrature
forward_metrics.column_units: ppm*m; approximate native column concentration, not a physical boundary-mass measurement
forward_metrics.scatter: Native 3sigma sphere cutoff, LOS and CalculateConcentrationSingleFilament in identical filament order; integrate columns without saving full 3D time bank
forward_metrics.parity_per_frame: 25 fixed equal-index points plus up to 25 nonzero points selected at equal ranks of sorted nonzero indices
